THE CITY OF LONDON INVESTMENT TRUST PLC
The Board of The City of London Investment Trust plc announces that:

A first interim dividend of 5.70p per ordinary share of 25p in respect of the year ending 30 June 2027 will be paid on 30 November 2026 to holders registered at the close of business on 23 October 2026. The Company's shares will trade ex-dividend on 22 October 2026.
